notes.title: Version 4.0.0 - Pals Pack Release and Online Beta!
notes.notes:
[p]We’re releasing the Pals Pack DLC publicly on Steam, and hosting an open public Beta of Online Versus for TWO WEEKS!  The Pals Pack is chockfull of other content like new challenges for you and your best buds to tackle, hats,  items, endless mode updates, a secret new playable character, and quality of life updates!  [/p][h2]New Online Versus Beta![/h2][list][*][p] A rotating game mode changes periodically; however, this can be changed on the character select screen (with the exception of ranked)
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Standard[/b]: Regular Matchmaking, fight a random player!
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Ranked[/b]: Ranked matchmaking, gain/lose rank with each battle and fight players of similar rank. In ranked both players use the same seed.
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Friends[/b]: Invite a friend and fight it out!
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Customization[/b]: Select a custom frame, banner and a style of junk blocks! You can also select up to four emotes to use in online matches.
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]VS Stats[/b]: Track your winrate, favourite characters and more!
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]VS mods[/b]: If both you and your opponent have the same mods enabled, they can be synced for online play!
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Note[/b]: Mods need to be downloaded from the Steam Workshop to work
[/p][/*][/list][h2]New Versus Modes[/h2][p]Race: First to complete three stages wins!
[/p][list][*][p] Gem Haul: First to earn 30,000 gems wins!
[/p][/*][*][p] Item Craze: Survival, way more items spawn
[/p][/*][*][p] Volleybomb: Juggle a giant bomb while clearing your board. If the bomb touches the opponent’s board, you earn a point! First to three points wins.
[/p][/*][*][p] Marathon: Survival, units spawn in waves.
[/p][/*][*][p] Legendary: Survival, with units and hazards form the Legendary Path
[/p][/*][*][p] Random: A random game mode will be selected each game.
[/p][/*][/list][h2]Chester’s Choice[/h2][list][*][p] A setting in Versus that has Chester choose a random game settings to activate each battle!
[/p][/*][/list][h2]New Versus Items[/h2][list][*][p] Warping Glass: Teleport units around you towards the opponent’s board.[/p][/*][*][p] Frost Bellow: Freezes the opponent’s board for 7 turns and the player for 5 turns. [/p][/*][*][p] Wobble Wand: For 10 turns, the opponent inputs are inverted.[/p][/*][*][p] Slamvil: Throws a giant anvil to the opponent.[/p][/*][*][p] Confuser: Transform an entire row on the opponent’s board into junk blocks. [/p][/*][*][p] Cube of Zorix: Shoots a laser horizontally on both boards. Deals damage to players.
[/p][/*][/list][h2]Versus Changes[/h2][list][*][p] CPU improvements
[/p][/*][*][p] CPU now has a level 10 difficulty (that blatantly cheats)
[/p][/*][*][p] “Shuffle All” is now the default level setting. Stage order is fully randomized and its difficulty is adjusted for how early/late the stage is in a match. The music for the match will be that of the first stage.
[/p][/*][*][p] Junk now scales with the gem meter. Chains send more junk with each bar of gem meter.
[/p][/*][*][p] Exit door now sends 4 junk instead of 8; however, it sends an additional 4 junk per stage ahead of the opponent.
[/p][/*][/list][h2]New Custom Hat presets[/h2][list][*][p] You can now create and save your own custom presets for your favourite hats! Pick up to 12 different hats per preset, equip them all with the press of a button and label them with their own preset names.
[/p][/*][/list][h2]New Hats[/h2][list][*][p] [b]Summoning Slouch:[/b] Random units spawn occasionally.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Monstrous Montera:[/b] Transform into a monster.
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Dungstalker[/b]: Beetos spawn everywhere.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Spinwulf Snood[/b]: Move two tiles at a time.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]No-Peek Nightcap[/b]: The UI is gone.
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Extrovert Hat:[/b] Can’t attack loner foes or blocks.
[/p][/*][/list][h2]Updated Endless Mode[/h2][list][*][p] You can now set the starting loop for endless mode from the hub. This will only affect the endless route and not other game modes (to do that, you can go into Settings -> Adventure)
[/p][/*][*][p] After loop 1, you’ll be able to meet Chester in Plains even after reaching the relic limit. This works until you amass 32 or more relics.
[/p][/*][*][p] When skipping loops, Chester will provide you an assortment of relics to choose from to give you a head start.
[/p][/*][*][p] Loop difficulty changes:
- Loop 1: Legendary units may show up
- Loop 2: Legendary hazards and big units may show up.
- Loop 3: Legendary units, big units and hazards show up more frequently. Future loops increase this chance.
- Random units start showing up rarely, increasing slightly in frequency each loop.
- Durability slightly decreases each loop starting on loop 5.
- One less chest each stage starting on loop 10.
- HP scales more on loops beyond 10.
[/p][/*][/list][h2]Changes[/h2][list][*][p] Prism Knight’s clones spawn with one more HP.
[/p][/*][*][p] Scrap Knight B no longer teleports units around if she moves after tossing her bag.
[/p][/*][*][p] Knights now have a waiting animation while fast-forwarding.
[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p] Fixed King Knight’s bash didn’t deal damage when bashing water tiles.
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed Shield Knight B wouldn’t recover her shield after defeating the Enchantress
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed Cogslotters wouldn’t drop their cog if flipped.
[/p][/*][*][p] Miscellaneous fixes.
[/p][/*][/list]

Hey there puzzlers!

We hope you’ve enjoyed solving the Pocket Dungeon's expanding mysteries in the base game, Puzzlers Pack DLC, and Paradox Pack DLC and we’re excited to keep the fun rolling with one last DLC. Today, we're excited to introduce to you the Pals Pack!

This final, update will bring long-awaited online support chockfull of verus mode challenges for you and your best buds to tackle, items, endless mode updates, and quality of life bug fixes! Get ready to battle it out with friends and foes worldwide.

Come release entire DLC Pack is currently FREE, so you’ll only need the base game to delve into the Pocket Dungeon’s new content.

With all that cool content in mind, developing a well-balanced game can be quite difficult  - especially if it’s a unique hybrid genre! So, just like for the Puzzler’s Pack and Paradox Pack, we thought it would be fun to invite you back to the Pocket Dungeon to help us make this DLC pack truly shine by releasing an Early Preview version.

Hey there Shovelheads!

[previewyoutube=ipwljVXp3Sw;full][/previewyoutube]

Grab your trusty shovel blade and delve into Shovel Knight’s next adventure! Shovel Knight Dig will release on Steam on September 23rd, 2022! (Which is tomorrow! Hooray!!!) If you haven't already, you can add Shovel Knight Dig to your wishlist! It'll notify you when the game is LIVE on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1416050/Shovel_Knight_Dig/

We poured our hearts into creating a new style of Shovel Knight gameplay: a fun, quirky, seamless world that ever changes as you furiously dig down - we think it’s quite special, and we hope you do too!

Here's some info about the game:

When Drill Knight and his dastardly digging crew blast apart Shovel Knight’s peaceful campsite and steal his loot, he grabs his trusty Shovel Blade and starts tunneling after them! But as he and Shield Knight soon discover, this adventure goes much deeper than a simple heist…

In true roguelike fashion, Shovel Knight’s path through the adventure is different every time you play! Shovel Knight Dig is packed with thousands of pixel-perfect level chunks, which are procedurally stitched together to create infinite combinations. Leap over danger, slash your foes, and dig your way down to hidden riches. Augment yourself by partaking in peculiar cuisine from the Gastronomole, studying Shovel Blade techniques from Master Argus, or taking your chances with Tom Bola! Back up at camp, spend your hard-earned loot to unlock new relics, armors, items and accessories. Get ready to dig in tomorrow!

notes.title: Shovel Knight roguelike gets four major updates
notes.notes:
Shovel Knight's post-launch support is the stuff of gaming legend, and even as developer Yacht Club Games has announced its next project, that doesn't mean the old dirt-minded hero is getting tossed to the side. The roguelike puzzle spinoff Shovel Knight: Pocket Dungeon launched late last year, and it's got at least four major updates coming soon.

First up is a free update with a range of "accessibility options, bug fixes, and quality of life improvements", as the devs explain in the announcement. This one will let you control how fast the board fills when you fall in battle, and will offer new stuff like additional portraits, tips after the match ends, and a CPU level display on the tally screen.

After that, there are three DLC packs on the way. An online versus mode will let you battle both friends and randos, a selection of new playable characters, enemies, and items will be coming, and mod support will hit the PC version.

notes.title: Shovel Knight's puzzle-adventure spin-off Pocket Dungeon gets December release date
notes.notes:
Shovel Knight Pocket Dungeon, in which developer Yacht Club Games' iconic spade-bearer embarks on a colourful blend of falling-block puzzling and dungeon-crawling, finally has a release date and will be making its way to Switch, PlayStation, and PC on 13th December.

Announced back in the early part of 2020, Shovel Knight Pocket Dungeon is a collaboration between Yacht Club Games and developer Vine that trades the titular hero's previous bouts of acclaimed platform action for top-down puzzling and adventuring. The goal is to work through each single-screen stage by clearing groups of adjacent enemies - lining them up with a quick spade-thwack to create massive chain attacks - in order to progress to the next area.

Complicating matters are the likes of keys, power-ups, health potions, new items, equipment, and boss battles. Additionally, challengers can choose from over 10 playable heroes from across the Shovel Knight universe, each with its own unique power and play style.
